purpose: This repository's start profiles: how each of its test boards starts, so a session can boot one without composing `start`'s arguments by hand.

files.start/m68k-dual.json: the `m68k-dual` test board (`radendur`) with its symbol table.
files.start/v30.json: the `v30` test board (`lineup`) on the shared MAME.
files.start/v30-alt.json: the `v30-alt` test board (`speedf`) on the shared MAME.
files.start/free.json: a free set from `MAME_TEST_ROMS`, its system and reference image given by the call.

notes: The board profiles name their paths through `MAME_LIVE_BENCH`, the folder of test programs. With it unset, the tests against a real emulator refuse every board by that name.
Each profile spells the directory and the system its board's `identity.json` gives. A folder that renames either keeps a `.scry/` of its own.
`v30`, `v30-alt` and `free` name the executable through `MAME_BINARY`, the one MAME the games are developed on.

`free` names its sets through `MAME_TEST_ROMS`. The reference image of a free set is unpacked per run, so the call gives `system`, `reference_rom`, `reference_addr` and `reference_base`, and those win over the profile's.
